sections.text: Introduction

This documents out lines the check list 
 I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 at the 
 titled block.

The first draft was initiated by eng. Al-Sayed Abdel Monem Al-Gegedawy, 
and tested on B.B. no. 1 at Fifth Urban Community 66kv Substation at 18 March 
2002, Cairo Zone.

Safety
Precautions

items:
A work permit 
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area must be used.
Wear safety helmet, safety shoes, masks

sections.text:
Environmental
Precautions

items:
Before start cleaning, wear breathing mask to protect lung tissues from dust 
particles and chemical solvent which, if exist, expose lungs to danger

Don't throw any cleaning liquid on ground, 
collect it and send to dumb.
Don't burn clothes used in cleaning, collect it and send to dumb

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
Draw circuit breakers out of Bus Bar.
Dismantle upper and lower shutters

Blow the dust and dirt out of Bus Bar (using vacuum 
cleaner)

Clean the upper contactors (related to Bus Bar) and 
lower contactors (related to cables)

Check current transformers to be well fixed, retighten 
bolts and screws and clean it.

Retighten bolts and screws at links between Bus Bar 
parts and at links between Bus Bar and contactors, also at links between cable 
ends and contactors

Check and clean potential transformer and its cell, 
also check and fix its capsules (cartridges), check and clean arresters

Check the heaters in the cells to be switched on, 
clean it, put the indicator of each heater at the suitable position

Check automatic fire fighting with sensible pipes, 
check the pipes to be far from cable ends put it away from any sharp edges, 
check the extinguisher cylinders to be in good condition

Check earthing switch of each feeder cell to be in 
good contact (as it switched on), check also that it moves is easily

Check cells to be well sealed and no way for rats to 
get into the cells

Clean the upper parts of cells and the instruments 
involved in it such as protection apparatus, timers, measuring instruments, etc, 
using video cleaner

Clean shutters well and put it in its places in the 
cells

Clean the passages that tracks across it in and out 
the cells, so breakers could get in and out of cells easily
Switch off earthing switches for all feeders cells

Put breakers in test position, switch on and off the 
breakers electrically, and then put them into their cells
